description.value: Discovery Foods is a 100% locally owned and operated grocery chain with two Vancouver Island locations; this listing covers the newly renovated Willow Point store in Campbell River on the South Island Highway. The store features a full-service deli with hot case foods, sushi, freshly made sandwiches and wraps, alongside fresh produce, meats, and an in-store bakery. An ATM is available on site, and the business actively supports local Vancouver Island farmers and small producers.
